instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium full shot. On a sunny rooftop under a blue sky with light clouds, a group of friends poses together. In the center foreground, the red-haired woman (R1) sits with eyes closed and a serene smile, wearing a white t-shirt and grey sweater. To her left, the grey-haired man (R2) sits in a grey t-shirt looking forward. In the background, the Asian woman (R5) stands on the left in a white shirt and black crop top, while the Black man (R6) stands on the right in a dark blue shirt. Bright daylight illuminates the scene with warm natural tones.
